subject: Fix multi dbs donot dbExpand when loading RDB (#12840)
reason: The change only flips when rdbLoadRioWithLoadingCtx pre-sizes a database's hash tables during RDB load: the old code armed should_expand_db once at entry, so only the first database in a multi-DB RDB got its dbExpand() and every subsequent SELECTDB's RESIZEDB hint was ignored; the fix re-arms the flag on each RESIZEDB so every DB is pre-sized. dbExpand only reserves dict capacity (dictExpand/dictTryExpand); a non-pre-sized dict rehashes incrementally to the identical end state. The loaded keys, values, expires, and all command replies are byte-for-byte identical on both builds. The only differ
